title: GTIN present
question: Do sampled products carry a GTIN?
method: Read gtin, gtin8, gtin12, gtin13 or gtin14 from the Product JSON-LD or its hasVariant Products, or global_unique_id from the Store API; a value counts only when it is 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits after spaces and hyphens are removed. Pass when at least 80 percent of sampled products have one; warn above 50 percent, or at or below it when every product without a GTIN carries brand and mpn, Google's documented alternative; fail when products without a GTIN also lack brand plus mpn.

title: GTIN valid
question: Are the GTINs real GTINs?
method: Each GTIN must be 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits and pass the GS1 check digit. Pass when all found GTINs are valid; fail when any is not.

title: Brand present as entity
question: Is the brand a Brand object with a consistent name?
method: Pass when Product.brand names the brand on all sampled products, as a Brand (or Organization) object with a name or as a bare string (noted: Google recommends brand.name on a Brand object); warn when the object lacks a name or has another type, or when the casing varies across the sample; fail when absent.

title: MPN present when GTIN absent
question: Do products without a GTIN have a brand plus MPN fallback?
method: For sampled products without a GTIN, pass when mpn and brand are both present. Skip when every sampled product has a GTIN.

title: SKU present and unique in sample
question: Does every sampled product have a SKU, and are they distinct?
method: Read sku (or productID, which Meta's on-page markup uses) from JSON-LD, or sku from the Store API; the field that supplied it is recorded. Pass when all sampled products have one and no two share it; warn on a duplicate; fail when missing.
